title: clematis smilacifolia var. subpeltata
intro: Clematis smilacifolia var. subpeltata, commonly known as a type of flowering vine in the Ranunculaceae family, is a plant used in traditional medicine. The plant is said to have various health benefits, including its potential to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. Research has identified its therapeutic actions as being primarily due to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of Clematis smilacifolia var. subpeltata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
